title: God is real! Ive seen it one too many times  in testimonies alone. Pa...
description: God is real! Ive seen it one too many times  in testimonies alone. Pay attention to everything happening around us. From fish dying, the the Euphrates river drying out, to the people who want to deliver the word but are being kicked out and banned from places for doing so. Another tiktoker just came on here a few weeks ago and told us what God told her to tell the people in New York now they have problem after problem! And yall are steady blaming it on climate change and the government. We as a people are running out of time. The bible says that 1,000 years for us, is a day to God! There is no time in God’s eyes. He says that “I am coming soon”… has it not already been 1000 years? All the evil happening in the world. All the killings! We’re so stuck in the present day that people put God on the back burner, but his word remains. Just because you forget, doesnt mean his word will fail. It is true and it will come to past. PRAY AND REPENT OF YOUR SINS! Ive been having dream after dream of God coming to get souls! Ive seen and heard people cry out to him! Im telling you because i truly believe that i am one of God’s vessels on earth and this is my assignment. Jesus Christ is thee, who was and is to come. Accept him as your Lord and Savior so that you may have eternal life. #lastdays #jesus #jesuslovesyou #revelation #repent
